scholarships.title: MAECI Italian Government Scholarship
scholarships.degree: Bachelor's, Master's, PhD, Research, Language courses
scholarships.official_source: Ministry of Foreign Affairs and International Cooperation (MAECI), Government of Italy

existing.description: The Italian Ministry of Foreign Affairs and International Cooperation awards scholarships to foreign students and Italian citizens resident abroad (IRE) under Italian law 288/55, to foster cultural, scientific and technological cooperation and to promote Italian language and culture. Scholarships are available only for academic courses taught on Italian territory, and the call sets out separate categories for degree study, research grants and shorter language or training courses. For academic year 2026-2027 applications were accepted exclusively through the Study in Italy portal and had to be received by 2 p.m. CET on 26 March 2026, so that cycle is closed. The ministry publishes the annual call, the English version and a list of eligible countries as PDF documents for each academic year.
existing.eligibility_summary: Under 28 for study grants, under 35 for research, valid passport, good academic standing
benefits: Exemption from university fees at public universities
coverage: Exemption from university fees at public universities
existing.english_requirement: Italian or English depending on programme
existing.best_fit: Students interested in Italian universities and culture
existing.notes: Do not confuse this grant with the Invest Your Talent in Italy programme, which is a separate MAECI special-project scholarship run with the Italian Trade Agency and Uni-Italia, and with scholarships offered directly by Italian universities. Coverage amounts are set inside the annual call (Bando), not on the ministry's HTML page.
existing.duration: 9 months from 1 November 2026 to 31 July 2027 for the main grant categories; 3-month grants run from 1 January 2027 and must end by 30 September 2027
existing.application_period: Annual call. For 2026-2027 the deadline was 26 March 2026 at 2 p.m. CET, with grants running from 1 November 2026
existing.program_type: Government scholarship of the Italian Republic (legal basis Law 288/55)
